newsitem.title: USA: Dow Jones index closes above 6,600 for first time.
newsitem.headline: Dow Jones index closes above 6,600 for first time.

text.p: The Dow Jones industrial average closed above 6,600 points for the first time Tuesday to set its second consecutive record as a wave of bargain hunting again lighted a flame under the market.

Based on early and unofficial data, the Dow ended up 33.48 points at a record of 6,600.66, surpassing Monday's milestone of 6,567.18. In the broader market, advancing issues led declines 14-10 on active volume of 541 million shares on the New York Stock Exchange. The Nasdaq index also set a record, rising 11.33 points to 1,327.73.
